::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 9th 1890  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS BL Add. 57517 ff.117
:::

Dear [Sir](people/person_788.qmd)
I suppose you must have a privately marked copy of the [Child’s Christian Year](other_books/otherbook_186.qmd), since it never was published with authors’ names.  My mother’s maiden name was [Frances Mary Bargus](people/person_1606.qmd), born Jan 13th 1795 - married to [William Crawley Yonge](people/person_1631.qmd) of the 52d regiment died Sept 28th 1868[^1]

I think all I care to have published about myself is already in biographical notices

I remain &c
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rev. John Julian (1839-1913), Vicar of Wincobank, and author of *A Dictionary of Hymnology* (1892).
